A warehouse receipt confirms that an item reached that stage, not that international delivery has begun. A submitted parcel may still be awaiting preparation or handover. Carrier acceptance is stronger evidence of movement within the carrier network than a tracking number that has merely been created. These are interpretive examples, not a list of exact labels guaranteed in every account.

For each stage, choose one next action. If the seller has not sent the product, ask about that order. If it is in the warehouse, review its photographs and shipping readiness. If a parcel has been paid for but lacks a dispatch update, ask whether handover has occurred. If the carrier has accepted it, use the carrier's latest scan and the route conditions. Mixing these stages often leads to asking the right question about the wrong reference number.

sections.title: The three-day tracking statement is not a delivery promise
paragraphs: Pikobuy's buying guide describes tracking information being available within three days after a parcel is dispatched. The reference point is dispatch, not the moment you buy a product, top up the balance or submit a parcel. That statement does not mean delivery within three days. Keep the dispatch timestamp and the tracking issue date separately so you can explain which step appears delayed when contacting support.

If you have a tracking number but the carrier does not recognise it, check for typing errors and confirm the carrier associated with that route. A number copied with spaces or punctuation may fail. A newly assigned reference can also precede a visible carrier scan. Do not infer the reason from the blank result alone. Ask Pikobuy to confirm the carrier, handover status and whether a different last-mile reference is expected. Share identifiers privately through the official support channel.

sections.title: Deal with a long gap without guessing the location
paragraphs: Record the exact last event, its timestamp and the website displaying it. A generic message such as transit or clearance does not reveal a parcel's precise physical location. Different tracking systems may update at different times or translate events differently. Compare the official carrier page with the account record, then ask which event is authoritative for the next step. Avoid treating an unrelated user's delivery time as a deadline for your own parcel.

If an estimated service window has passed, send one concise support request containing the parcel reference, route, dispatch date, last scan and the action you want confirmed. Ask whether an investigation can be opened and what evidence or waiting period applies. Retain the response and follow the stated process. An investigation request is not approval of compensation, and a lack of new scans by itself does not prove that the parcel is lost or held by customs.

sections.title: When tracking says delivered but you cannot find it
paragraphs: Check the delivery address, carrier proof of delivery where available, building reception, household members and any authorised delivery location. If those checks do not resolve it, contact the last-mile carrier promptly and report the discrepancy to Pikobuy with the same timeline. Do not publicly post your full address or a label containing personal details while asking other users for help. Preserve screenshots and the case reference in one place.

If the parcel arrives damaged, photograph the outer packaging, label and visible damage before discarding anything. Keep the contents and packaging while checking the applicable reporting process. Describe observations precisely: a crushed corner, a torn seam or a missing item is more useful than a general complaint. The responsible party and any compensation depend on the route and relevant terms; neither a screenshot nor this checklist guarantees a refund. Use the evidence to support the appropriate claim.

articles.title: Is Pikobuy Legit? Fees, QC and Returns Explained
articles.description: A source-based Pikobuy review: understand the service, payment stages, warehouse checks, return limits and questions to resolve before ordering.
articles.summary: Pikobuy publishes a buying process and service policies, but those documents alone do not prove that every order will be successful. This independent review explains what the public evidence supports and how to assess a proposed purchase. It is not a personal delivery test, an authenticity certificate or a guarantee of safety.

sections.title: What this review can establish
paragraphs: When someone asks whether Pikobuy is legitimate, several questions can be hidden inside that word. They may want to know whether the website operates a purchasing service, whether a particular seller will fulfil an order, whether a product is authentic, or whether a parcel will arrive. Those are separate questions requiring different evidence. The public guides explain the intended workflow; they do not establish the outcome of an individual transaction or the financial protection available through every payment method.

Our review is based on the linked official buying guide and published terms checked on 28 October 2026. We did not place a test order or independently audit Pikobuy's operations for this article. We therefore do not award a numerical trust score, claim a personal delivery time or describe every listing as verified. Use the following checks to understand the arrangement you are considering, then confirm the details in your own account before paying.

sections.title: Understand the parties involved
paragraphs: The service agreement distinguishes the platform's search and display functions, third-party purchasing services and third-party logistics. That matters because a problem with a seller's product is different from a problem with a parcel in transit. Before buying, identify the original marketplace listing and keep the selected variation. Before shipping, identify the route and the party handling delivery. A single product card does not explain all of those relationships.

Pikobuy.at is a separate, independent directory and guide site. Browsing here does not create an order, and our editorial pages cannot inspect your balance or change your shipment. Registration, payment and account support take place on the official Pikobuy service. Check the address of the page where you sign in. A similar name, a shared product photograph or a social-media recommendation is not enough to establish that another website is the official service.

sections.title: Review costs before the first payment
paragraphs: An item price is only one part of the decision. Allow separate lines for the product, domestic delivery, international freight, selected services and unresolved import or payment costs. Distinguish money deposited into an account from money spent on an order, so the same amount is not counted twice. Make sure you can explain the next payment being requested and which item or parcel it covers. If a total is unclear, request a breakdown before approving it.

The published service agreement describes an 8% platform charge on shipping; it should not be presented as a universal 8% charge on the merchandise price. Check whether a displayed shipping amount includes that fee before adding anything yourself. Conditions and settlement can vary, so a generic review cannot replace the actual payment summary. Promotional claims about free purchasing services should not be read as a promise of free freight or a zero-cost delivered order.

sections.title: Use warehouse checks for observable questions
paragraphs: The buying guide describes photographs and inspection after warehouse arrival. For your order, compare the selected size, colour, quantity and visible condition with the warehouse evidence. If the photographs cannot answer a specific concern, ask for the missing angle or measurement and confirm any charge. A close-up of a seam or a clearly positioned measuring tape can support a decision more effectively than a vague request to check whether everything is good.

Photographs have limits. They do not establish long-term durability, hidden construction, electrical safety or brand authenticity. Catalogue images also do not prove the condition of the unit bought for you. Keep those distinctions in mind when reading reviews that describe an item as checked. Ask what was actually observed, who observed it and whether the evidence refers to the same product variation and order. Avoid making a purchase that depends on a property nobody has verified.

sections.title: Check the return route before you need it
paragraphs: The published policy describes a five-day, 120-hour application window for eligible items in the warehouse, alongside seller consent and condition requirements. It also identifies exclusions and possible return costs. Check the timestamp and current eligibility of the specific item. Do not assume that the word guarantee means an unconditional refund for every product, or that an item remains equally easy to return after international dispatch.

If you discover a discrepancy, preserve labels, accessories and packaging while asking what action is available. Supply the selected variation, order reference and evidence of the problem. Requesting a return, receiving approval and receiving money back are separate events. Ask where a refund will be credited and what charges apply to the particular case. The policy contains wording that requires an order-specific explanation of shipping costs; obtain that explanation instead of treating a short summary as a fixed refund quotation.

sections.title: Assess the shipping decision on its own evidence
paragraphs: Before submitting a parcel, confirm the destination, packed weight, dimensions, contents and route conditions. An early estimate based on guessed dimensions can differ from the later charge. Compare complete payable amounts and read any insurance terms, exclusions and reporting procedure. If the route does not explain an important condition, ask support about the actual parcel. A low displayed freight price is useful only when the service is suitable for those contents and that destination.

After dispatch, keep the parcel reference and carrier information. A tracking number being created is not the same as a carrier scan, and a scan is not a promise of a particular delivery date. If the shipment stops updating, use the last recorded event and applicable route conditions to frame your enquiry. Reviews of other parcels can provide context, but they do not establish the status or compensation entitlement of your own shipment.

sections.title: Warning signs that justify pausing a purchase
paragraphs: Pause when the original listing cannot be matched to the imported product, when the payment breakdown cannot be explained, or when a requested variation is replaced without your agreement. Also pause if someone asks for your account password through an unofficial channel or pressures you to ignore a mismatch. These are practical checks for a transaction, not allegations about a particular company. Keep evidence and seek clarification through the official support route.

A useful support question asks for one verifiable answer: which seller listing will be purchased, what the additional amount covers, whether the item is eligible for a return, or which carrier accepts the parcel. Save the answer with the order record. A generic reassurance is less useful than information tied to your actual situation. If the response leaves a condition essential to your decision unresolved, you can decide not to proceed with that purchase.

sections.title: Decide whether the process suits your needs
paragraphs: This purchasing workflow requires several decisions across product selection, warehouse review and international shipping. Consider whether you have time to review arrivals, whether you can tolerate uncertain delivery timing and whether the complete estimated cost fits your budget. A date-critical purchase or one requiring professional authentication may need evidence and service commitments that these public pages do not supply. Define those requirements before comparing a low product price with another buying option.

If you proceed, start with a clear record of what you selected and why, check each payment stage and keep the relevant support responses. After delivery, compare the outcome with that record. Your experience can help you assess another order, but it should be described with its actual dates, destination and route rather than turned into a universal promise. The most useful answer to whether Pikobuy suits you comes from these specific conditions and the evidence available for your transaction.

articles.title: Pikobuy Shipping to Germany: Costs, Tracking and Parcel Checks
articles.description: Plan a Pikobuy parcel for Germany: compare shipping inputs, check current import information, prepare documents and follow the carrier handover.
articles.summary: For Germany, price and timing depend on the actual parcel and the route available at submission. Use the official calculator for a dated estimate, check current German import guidance and follow the carrier named in your shipment. This guide does not promise a fixed freight price, delivery time or tax-free route.

sections.title: Begin with a Germany-specific parcel plan
paragraphs: Select Germany as the destination in the official shipping calculator and use the product type, estimated packed weight and outer dimensions. Keep a note of what is confirmed and what is assumed. If you have not bought the items yet, the result is a planning estimate. Once the warehouse supplies relevant measurements, update the same worksheet. This makes it possible to explain a changed quotation rather than comparing two totals built from different parcels.

Set a maximum delivered budget before ordering. Include the product purchase, domestic delivery, freight, selected services and any unresolved import or handling charges. A German destination does not create a universal price per kilogram, and this site has not verified a cheapest route for every parcel. Compare the options actually offered for your contents and address. If no appropriate route is available, resolve that question before increasing the value of the basket.

sections.title: Compare weight and packaging consistently
paragraphs: A light but bulky box may be charged differently from a compact parcel with the same scale weight. Read the charging rule for the selected route. If it uses volumetric weight, follow that route's divisor and rounding method instead of applying a formula from an unrelated carrier. Record the outer box dimensions, not a garment's measurements or the length of a shoe. Those measurements answer different questions and should not share the same field.

For shoes, ask whether keeping the retail box changes the packed size and what protection is provided if it is removed. For clothing, consider whether a proposed packing change can damage a print or accessory. Do not request changes that could affect a pending return before resolving the item decision. Compare realistic options using revised measurements and any packing charge. Removing packaging is not automatically a saving if it changes protection or adds another cost.

sections.title: Recheck import information for the shipment date
paragraphs: Older advice that treats every parcel below EUR 150 as exempt from customs duty is unsuitable for current planning. DHL's German import guidance describes changes effective 1 July 2026, including a general EUR 3 duty per product category for qualifying low-value online shipments from outside the EU. The applicable declaration and collection process depends on the shipment. Read the current official guidance linked below and ask the carrier how it applies to the proposed route.

Do not turn that summary into a universal total tax calculation. The number of declared product categories, the goods, their value and the applicable procedure matter. Keep freight, import charges and carrier handling charges distinct in your budget. If a route describes certain charges as included, obtain the specific written conditions and retain them. A route name or a promotional phrase by itself does not establish which costs are covered or guarantee clearance.

sections.title: Prepare records before a request arrives
paragraphs: Keep the product descriptions, quantities, order confirmations, payment records and shipping breakdown together. Descriptions should identify what the goods actually are, rather than using a vague label for an entire mixed parcel. If a carrier or customs authority requests documentation, use the channel and instructions in the verified notice. Do not invent a lower value or describe a commercial purchase as a private gift merely to obtain a different charge.

Save the submitted information and any response with the parcel reference. If the figures on an invoice and payment record differ, explain the reason with supporting records rather than editing one to match without explanation. This checklist is a way to organise evidence, not a substitute for the authority's instructions. The documents required for your shipment should be confirmed by the responsible carrier or customs office when the situation arises.

sections.title: Check the delivery address and local handover
paragraphs: Review the recipient name, street, house number, postal code and city before paying for international shipping. Include any address detail required by the selected carrier. Do not assume that a route can deliver to every collection point or locker merely because another service can. If a Packstation, parcel shop or alternative delivery address is essential, obtain confirmation for the actual route before submitting the parcel. A normal residential address and a collection facility are not interchangeable destinations.

Keep contact information accurate in the account and watch for an authentic delivery notification. If a local carrier reference is supplied later, save it alongside the original international number. The two identifiers may describe different parts of the same journey. Use the carrier named in the shipment rather than guessing from another shopper's route. Do not enter payment details through an unexpected message link until you have verified the request through the carrier's official website or account.

sections.title: Read tracking as a sequence of events
paragraphs: Separate the seller's delivery to the warehouse from the international parcel. A warehouse arrival is a product checkpoint; it is not evidence that the parcel has left for Germany. Similarly, a tracking number can exist before a visible carrier acceptance scan. Record the dispatch date, carrier and last event so you know which part of the process you are asking about. The official buying guide's tracking-information statement should not be interpreted as a three-day delivery promise.

When scans pause, compare the account record with the official carrier page and keep the exact wording and timestamps. A generic clearance or transit message does not establish the parcel's precise physical location. If the route's stated window has passed or a requested action is unclear, contact support with the parcel reference and last event. Ask whether information is needed from you and which party can open an investigation. Avoid making a second payment unless its purpose is verified.

sections.title: Respond to collection or documentation notices promptly
paragraphs: A notice may require documents, payment or collection, but the action and deadline should come from the verified notice itself. Read it completely and preserve a copy. If it concerns a customs office, use the official contact details to clarify the requested records. If it concerns a carrier, use that carrier's support channel. Do not assume that every parcel follows the same procedure or that waiting indefinitely will resolve a missing-document request.

If a charge appears to duplicate an amount already paid, compare the type of charge, the period and the parcel reference. Freight, import charges and handling fees are different lines; two amounts can look similar without being the same charge. Send the relevant evidence and request an explanation before making assumptions. Keep the response and receipt together so that any later enquiry can distinguish a disputed charge from one that has already been settled.

sections.title: Close the parcel record after delivery
paragraphs: Check the outer packaging and contents against the order and warehouse records. If something is damaged or missing, keep the packaging and record the visible condition before discarding material. Contact the relevant support channel with the parcel number, photographs and a concise description. The route's reporting and claims terms determine the next steps; this checklist does not guarantee compensation or assign responsibility without evidence.

Finally, compare the confirmed delivered cost and actual timeline with your original estimate. Record which assumptions changed, such as packaging size, an additional document request or a different last-mile handover. That record can improve a future estimate, but it is specific to this parcel. A later order with different contents, dimensions or shipping conditions needs a fresh comparison. Use the related cost and tracking guides below for the general workflow while checking Germany's current requirements separately.

articles.title: Pikobuy Shipping to the USA: Estimates, Tracking and Delivery
articles.description: A practical US parcel checklist covering shipping estimates, current import guidance, carrier tracking, address checks and delivery problems.
articles.summary: For a US destination, compare routes using the actual parcel and verify current import requirements before dispatch. Do not rely on an old duty-free threshold or a generic delivery promise. Keep the product order, warehouse checks and international tracking record separate so that each problem reaches the appropriate support channel.

sections.title: Start with the actual US destination
paragraphs: Choose the United States in the official shipping calculator and enter the parcel information it requests. Check the destination details and route eligibility before treating a displayed estimate as useful. A quote based on guessed weight and dimensions remains provisional. Keep the inputs and the date, then update them when the warehouse record provides better information. A comparison without its underlying parcel measurements cannot explain why the final amount changed.

If the delivery address is outside the contiguous states, a territory, a military address or another special address type, ask whether the specific route supports it. Do not assume that a generic United States selector establishes service to every address. You do not need to place a product order to define this requirement. Resolve essential destination limitations early, particularly when an alternative address or delivery method would make the purchase unsuitable for you.

sections.title: Keep freight separate from the delivered budget
paragraphs: Your worksheet should distinguish merchandise, domestic delivery to the warehouse, international freight, optional services and unresolved import or handling charges. Also distinguish account top-ups from charges against the balance. Counting both as purchases overstates the cost. For each line, note whether it is confirmed, estimated or still unknown. A missing amount should not silently become zero when deciding whether the order fits your budget.

The final shipping decision should use the packed weight and outer dimensions. Read the route's charging rule and check whether the displayed amount includes the applicable platform fee. If two routes look similar, compare their complete conditions, accepted contents and any additional services. A lower headline quote is not necessarily a lower remaining total. This guide does not provide a live rate table or a universal cheapest route because those claims require a current, parcel-specific quotation.

sections.title: Do not use an old US duty-free assumption
paragraphs: US Customs and Border Protection's published guidance says the previous de minimis treatment for shipments valued at or below USD 800 is no longer generally available under the suspension described in its current notices. An older shopping guide repeating an automatic USD 800 exemption can therefore give a misleading budget. Consult the current CBP guidance linked below and ask the carrier or responsible broker how the applicable entry and charges will be handled for your goods.

This article does not calculate a tariff rate for your parcel. Goods classification, origin, value, applicable rules and the entry process can affect the result, and those details cannot be inferred from a catalogue photograph. Do not treat freight payment as proof that every import-related amount has been paid. If a route says charges are included, keep the specific conditions and seek clarification about exclusions or additional handling costs before submitting the shipment.

sections.title: Organise accurate product and payment records
paragraphs: Keep item descriptions, quantities, original listings, order confirmations and payment evidence with the shipping record. If someone responsible for clearance requests documents, follow the verified request and provide accurate information through the appropriate channel. A mixed parcel should not be described using a vague label that hides its contents. Do not lower a value or relabel a purchase as a gift simply to obtain a different customs outcome.

If a product has characteristics that could affect whether it may be imported or carried, resolve those questions before ordering or packing. The presence of a listing in a directory is not confirmation that it is admissible or accepted by every carrier. Ask about the specific item and route and consult the relevant official guidance. Keep the response so that the parcel decision is based on its actual contents, rather than on a general statement about shopping from overseas.

sections.title: Verify the address before the parcel is submitted
paragraphs: Check the recipient name, street number, street name, apartment or unit, city, state and ZIP Code. An omitted unit number can make a correct building address insufficient for delivery. Confirm whether the selected service accepts a PO Box or another special destination before using it. Do not copy an address from a previous order without checking that it is still correct. Correcting it before dispatch is a different problem from redirecting a parcel already moving through a carrier network.

Keep contact information current and save the address as submitted. If an address issue appears later, share the relevant record privately with official support. Avoid posting a full label, phone number or account screenshot in a public tracking discussion. When an unexpected text or email asks for an address correction or payment, open the carrier's official site independently and verify the request there. A message containing a plausible tracking number is not enough by itself to establish authenticity.

sections.title: Track the handover to the named carrier
paragraphs: A seller order, a warehouse item and an international parcel have different references. Begin by identifying which record you are viewing. A product reaching the warehouse does not mean it has been dispatched to the United States. After international dispatch, save the carrier name and tracking number, and record any separate last-mile reference supplied later. Use the actual carrier associated with the shipment; do not assume every US parcel is handled by USPS.

A number may be assigned before the carrier displays an acceptance event. If the number is unrecognised, confirm that it was copied correctly and that you are using the correct carrier page. Ask Pikobuy to clarify the handover status if the gap remains unexplained. A scan marked transit or clearance should be read as an event, not a precise location or a guarantee of delivery by a certain date. Compare timestamps before concluding that two tracking pages contradict one another.

sections.title: Investigate a stalled shipment through the right channel
paragraphs: CBP's help guidance states that it cannot track ordinary purchases for consumers and directs missing-package questions first to the seller and carrier. A claim that a parcel is with customs is not proof of that location. Start with the exact last scan, dispatch date, route and parcel reference. Ask the carrier or Pikobuy which party can open an investigation and whether any action or documentation is required from you.

If you receive an official detention, documentation or other formal notice, follow its instructions and use the issuing authority's verified contact details. Keep that notice with the shipping record. Do not replace the notice's process with a generic forum waiting period. The relevant deadlines and available options depend on the actual situation. An enquiry, a carrier investigation and a compensation claim are distinct actions, and accepting one does not establish the outcome of the others.

sections.title: Resolve delivery problems with specific evidence
paragraphs: When tracking shows delivered but the parcel is missing, check the address, household members, building reception and any authorised delivery location. Look for proof of delivery where the carrier provides it. If those checks do not resolve the discrepancy, contact the last-mile carrier promptly and notify Pikobuy with the same timeline. Preserve case numbers and responses so the two enquiries do not develop conflicting accounts of what happened.

If the parcel arrives damaged, record the packaging and contents before discarding anything. Compare missing or incorrect items with the order and warehouse evidence, then describe the discrepancy precisely. Review the applicable claims procedure and reporting deadline rather than assuming that a shipping payment or an optional service covers every loss. After the issue is resolved, reconcile the actual costs and dates with your planning worksheet. Use that experience as evidence for a future estimate, while recognising that another parcel may face different conditions.
